Processes.Name: KOGE1000: Screen landzone applications
Processes.Description: Køge Kommune landzone PoC. Twice daily (07:00/19:00 Copenhagen) reads unread non-complaint emails from Landzone.AI.PoC@koege.dk, runs an AI completeness analysis (analysis only, no text generation) against Køge's landzone screening prompt, upserts the Microsoft List row by Sagsnummer when the email contains one, notifies the caseworkers via SMTP, and marks the email as read only after success. Failed emails stay unread for the next run and trigger an alert via KOGE1002.
